written.headline: Anthropic mathematician claims to have solved Riemann hypothesis with Claude
written.summary: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge published a claim that he used Claude to prove the Riemann hypothesis, a 167-year-old open mathematical problem. The solution has not yet been independently verified by experts or accepted by the Clay Mathematics Institute.

written.headline: Thinking Machines Lab releases Inkling 2 Mini open-weights model
written.summary: Thinking Machines Lab released Inkling 2 Mini, a 26.4B-parameter open-weights Mixture-of-Experts transformer that loops its middle layers three times per token. The ~20GB model is small enough to run on consumer laptops and leads open-weights models under 100B parameters on benchmarks like DeepSWE v1.1.

written.headline: Trump threatens tax and ban on US companies building data centers overseas
written.summary: President Donald Trump stated that U.S. companies will be blocked from building data centers overseas or face a heavy tax. Major cloud providers including Alphabet, Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, and Oracle have already built data centers in other countries.

written.headline: Mistral launches public preview of Mistral Large 4
written.summary: Mistral has launched a public preview of Mistral Large 4, a 1-trillion-parameter natively multimodal model with 52 billion active parameters. The preview API is available on Mistral Studio, with weights releasing at the end of the month.

written.headline: METR updates AI time horizon report with harder tasks and judgment focus
written.summary: Nonprofit evaluation group METR released an update to its time horizon report, finding that while frontier AI models continue rapid capability gains on verifiable tasks like coding, their performance lags on open-ended tasks requiring judgment. The updated TH2 suite tests models on 36 tasks across 12 families, showing that time horizons double roughly every 110 days.

written.headline: Researcher tests AI supply chain with 2 million canaries and finds data leaks
written.summary: Security researcher HD Moore planted nearly 2 million trackable secrets in prompts sent through AI services to test for data leakage between July and November 2026. The experiment uncovered compromised AI providers, prompt logging by resellers, and ignored privacy settings.

written.headline: Levent Alpöge reports discovering proof of Riemann Hypothesis with Claude
written.summary: Mathematician Levent Alpöge stated that he discovered a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis while working with Anthropic's Claude model. According to the report, the AI model also helped formalize the arguments without assumptions.

written.headline: Anthropic Nasdaq debut sparks buying rush among Indian retail investors
written.summary: Anthropic's Nasdaq debut drove heavy trading activity among Indian retail investors across overseas platforms including INDmoney, Mudrex, and Vested. The company accounted for 40% of INDmoney's international investment activity and 11% of total traded value on Vested on its listing day.
